definitions.explanation: To become part of a group.
For something to be added to an existing amount.

examples.japanese: グループに{加|くわ}わる。
{新|あたら}しいメンバーが{加|くわ}わった。
{議論|ぎろん}に{加|くわ}わった。
{費用|ひよう}がさらに{加|くわ}わった。
{税金|ぜいきん}が{加|くわ}わると、{値段|ねだん}はもっと{高|たか}くなる。
examples.english: When tax is added, the price becomes even higher.

notes:
{加|くわ}わる means to join a group or for something to be added—an intransitive verb describing the act of becoming part of something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {加|くわ}える (transitive, to add something)

PATTERN:
Xに{加|くわ}わる: to join X

COMMON PATTERNS:
- グループに{加|くわ}わる: to join a group
- チームに{加|くわ}わる: to join a team
- {議論|ぎろん}に{加|くわ}わる: to join a discussion
- {力|ちから}が{加|くわ}わる: force is added

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加|くわ}わる: to join (intransitive)
- {参加|さんか}する: to participate
